item.title: Understanding the valuation of intangible assets in tech deals
item.description: In a technology M&A deal, whether you are acquiring or selling a tech or software business, valuation rarely hinges on a single dimension. Financial performance, growth efficiency, and cash flow durability remain the backbone of any transaction. item.title: Munich 2026: A security conference where tech isn’t an afterthought
item.description: The 62nd Munich Security Conference opened on 13 February 2026 in Munich, Germany, and this year’s gathering feels different from past editions.
